title: Cyrus and the Gravity
author: Zephyrine Vasquez
blurb: Ulyana Marchetti, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
